scope: Proposition 3.4 (Simultaneous normalization) of the manuscript “The Mahler Conjecture for General Convex Bodies” (preprints/The-Mahler-Conjecture-for-General-Convex-Bodies-September-22-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 087 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f2d35982e2e7dfe5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: A linear transformation of the cone data and a symmetric T in the prescribed spectral box can be chosen so that EA = 0, λT2 + C ◦ T + K = 0, H := −C − 2λT ≥ m∗I, C = EC(L), K = EK(L). (8) Matrix functions here and below use spectral calculus for symmetric matrices.
